{{Quote|Deadly accurate with a blaster, but has a reputation for laziness. I'm surprised he made it this far.|[[Mako (slicer)|Mako]]|<ref name="TOR:TtS">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Tracking the Smuggler|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
'''Veeboo Lunx''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|You're probably wondering why an amazing bounty hunter like myself quit the Great Hunt and let Tyresius go. The answer's simple: more credits than I'd ever earn chasing bounties for the rest of my life. Even if I won the Great Hunt!|Veeboo Lunx, to the [[Hunter (individual)|Hunter]]|<ref name="TOR:CV" />}}
In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates" /> Veeboo was a competitor in the [[Great Hunt (c. 3643 BBY)|Great Hunt]].<ref name="TOR:TtS" /> Over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], Lunx was tasked with tracking down the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] conman [[Gault Rennow]], and Lunx successfully shot down Lokai's ship over the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]].<ref name="TOR:TTT">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|The Tatooine Target|the D5-Mantis}}</ref> However, Lokai bribed Lunx to drop out of the Hunt and sell him his own [[Veeboo Lunx's starship|ship]],<ref name="TOR:TtS" /> giving the Rodian more credits than he would have received in the competition, and also offered him a bounty on [[Hunter (individual)|Lunx's rival]] in the search for Lokai. Lunx began to party in the [[Varath cantina|cantina]] in [[Outpost Varath]], but his rival tracked him down and confronted him about dropping out. Lunx turned on the hunter with several hired thugs, but was ultimately [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the firefight.<ref name="TOR:CV" />
